source_event.summary: Independent audit found a callback-versus-initial-write ordering escape; the remediated candidate routes both producers through one monotonic Serializable state machine.

generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: An asynchronous workflow accepts terminal callbacks while a slower initiating request later persists an older intermediate result into the same record, regressing durable truth.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Protect callback-to-callback transitions but let the initial request write its cached intermediate snapshot directly after the callback has already finalized the record.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: All producers that mutate the same asynchronous lifecycle must use one persisted monotonic transition function with terminal precedence and fresh state inside the atomic boundary.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Exercise reordering where a terminal callback commits before the initiating writer attempts to persist an older intermediate result, plus terminal failure and a weaker local-state sibling.

transfer_cases.scenario: settled callback commits before checkout request persists processing
completed callback commits before enqueue request persists queued

skill_changes.change: callback and initiating producers are governed by the same monotonic persisted-state rule through the conversational-flow composition contract
risk saturation and reusable escape catalog activate ordering/concurrency controls whenever asynchronous producers share lifecycle state
